name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '12' is a valid chapter ID (1-30 domain range), not an address residue (function is at 0x237d5, unrelated to 12). Descriptor 'end' correctly reflects its role as the chapter-12 end handler dispatched via the chapter-end handler pointer table (xref from data @ 0x51E15).
purpose: Chapter 12 (北山道) end handler: stages the post-battle recruit scene, plays the closing cutscene, persists the party, recruits 米亞斯多德 (char id 0x11), and advances the current-chapter id.
logic_summary: Unconditionally copies three 14-byte scene tables (recruit-scene X @ 0x52129 / Y @ 0x52137 / facing @ 0x52145) into three on-stack placement blocks. Calls fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro(x,y,facing,0,0xd,0xe,0xa,2,0,4,0) to place chars 0..0xD plus extra char 0xE at tile (0xA,2) facing 0, camera origin (4,0). Then plays the cutscene: fd2_display_dialog_scene(text,3,...); fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x2D); fd2_display_dialog_scene(text,4,...). Persists party via fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template(), recruits char #17 (0x11 = 米亞斯多德) via fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(0x11), then INC current_chapter_id. In the binary the tail is `JMP 0x239B1` into the shared `INC [0x53c03]; RET` snippet that closes fd2_chapter_13_end; emitted as a self-contained function (Layer 2 functional equivalence). The leading __CHK(0x68,...) is the Watcom compiler-inserted stack-probe (not game logic), correctly absent from the C source.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: stages scene, plays cutscene/dialog, persists party, recruits char 0x11, and increments the global current-chapter id.
